A8Analogue

Sample & Hold

Sample, hold and smooth

Samples a voltage on every trigger and holds it. With no input patched it samples internal noise and produces random voltages.

  • Switchable between sample & hold and track & hold
  • SLEW smooths the steps up to about 1 s
  • Internal noise as a source
